title: claude-real-video lets Claude actually watch a video instead of just reading its transcript

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Claude rail video lets Claude actually watch a video instead of just reading its transcript. Paste a YouTube link into most tools and the model never sees a single frame. Gemini samples at a fixed one per second and misses fast cuts entirely. This detects real scene changes so a 10-minute static slide collapses to one frame while a rapid cut reel keeps every beat. It ddupes repeated shots, transcribes the audio, and hands you a folder any model can
